summary: CaliberCos Inc. filed an 8-K on September 14, 2026, disclosing a note exchange program launched in September 2026 for holders of its unsecured promissory notes. Holders may convert notes into subordinated amortizing notes bearing 6% interest payable monthly, into Series AAA Convertible Preferred Stock, or grant the company a Payoff Option to repurchase notes at 80% of face. As of September 14, 2026, note holders converted and cancelled $12.6 million of debt: $2.9 million into new notes, $0.6 million into preferred stock, and $9.1 million into the Payoff Option. The preferred stock carries registration rights for underlying common shares. The filing also reports unregistered sales of equity securities tied to the preferred conversion. The Payoff Option and standstill agreement effectively allow a discounted debt retirement, creating potential equity dilution and overhang; watch for conversion pricing, preferred terms, and whether additional holders join the program.
